card.name: Linking words in psychology theory text
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (of, by, and, as, the, an opening quote or bracket) in psychology and behavioral science passages. They come just before a named theory, theorist or effect.

modes.label: Link before a named effect
modes.description: A small word such as of, as or an opening quote comes right before a named psychological effect or concept.
modes.example: the effect is essentially a type<< of>> self-fulfilling prophecy.

modes.label: Link among theorist names
modes.description: A small word or bracket comes between or after the names of psychology theorists.
